title: smoke gate: is the plumbing alive
purpose: Zero points. Its only job is to tell you your plumbing works before you invest in semantics: a tiny dataset, no chaos, and every assertion here is one you can fix in minutes. If S0 is green and S1 is not, the problem is semantics, not wiring.

golden.digest_pinned_by: reference run reviewed 2026-09-01: 87 proposals, 86 posted, 1 business rejection, 15 exceptions, 3 SOAP calls, every planted trap firing exactly once. Re-pinned after the outbound ack journal was removed from the digest walk; the earlier pin hashed the run id and could not be reproduced.

steps.note: a clean run on both services before anything is seeded
the ERP dataset plus the twin's pre-seeded cost centers and unit conversions
one last scan so a batch published just before exit is picked up

assert.title: the connector exits 0 or 2
assert.why: 2 means completed with business exceptions and is the normal outcome of an exception-driven product, not a failure

assert.title: run.json, postings.csv and exceptions.csv exist and carry the contract schema
run.json echoes the run id the harness supplied
assert.why: the run id is ours; a connector that invents one cannot be resumed with the same id

assert.title: at least one batch reached the twin
the legacy delivery was parsed inside the twin, not pre-transformed outside it
assert.why: the connector relays the KRED-EXP bytes unparsed and declares profile kredexp-2.1; the twin owns the parse

assert.title: every batch got a complete receipt, DONE included
every record the twin saw reached exactly one terminal state
the retryable FX fault was retried and the permanent one was not
no source document was posted twice
the run fits the published request budget
the twin's state digest
assert.why: the digest is a hash over natural keys and payloads only, so it is blind to channel, format and batching
